Review required

Ready for a fictional request.

A human chooses the final category in every case.

Relative model scores compare these four categories. They are not calibrated confidence and do not prove a request belongs to any of them.

What influenced the suggestion?

Positive contributions favour the leading category; negative contributions favour its nearest alternative. These are learned word associations, not an understanding of the request.

03 / Make the method inspectable

Small model. Clear boundaries.

This is supervised, classical machine learning implemented in JavaScript. It is not an LLM or generative-AI system.

01

Fit on training data only

Lowercase English tokens become word counts. Class priors and smoothed word likelihoods are learned from the training partition. Validation and held-out text do not enter the vocabulary or fitted counts.

log P(class) + Σ count(word) × log P(word | class)

02

Explain the association

The largest word contributions compare the leading class with the runner-up. Laplace smoothing uses α = 1. Unknown words are ignored by the classifier and remain visible in its coverage note.

Word order and meaning are not modelled. Negation, mixed topics, unfamiliar language and repeated words can mislead it.

03

Apply a separate review gate

The fixed heuristic flags fewer than two distinct known words, vocabulary coverage below 45%, or a leading log-score gap below 0.25 per recognised word. It is not a learned detector or a guarantee of correctness.

These thresholds were set before evaluating the bundled held-out set. Every decision still requires human selection.

Inspect the dataset and fitted model

Training vocabulary

Built from training records only. No stemming or stop-word removal.

Partition checks catch repeated IDs and identical tokenised text. They do not prove semantic independence or detect every near-paraphrase.
